decision_time: M1 open time + 60 seconds; index <= LastClosedIndex(_m1Bars)
anchor: native completed entry bar; decision_bar = decision_index - anchor_index
normalization: native risk frozen at arming; ATR14 computed separately at each historical completed bar
missing_policy: reject entire research run; no padding, imputation or skipped legal actions
label_custody: Outcome is training target only. Runtime encoder receives only explicit trajectory and causal static allowlist.
